facts.fact: INSA announced on 9 December 2025 that it had officially launched the National Country Sign Certificate Authority, a root certificate authority now issuing digital certificates for the security of the Fayda digital ID.

ETH.note: Nothing on civil register and ID links.
INSA is not described as the national response body; no incident, strategy or designation stated.
No enrolment count or share is stated.
Nothing on a number at birth.
Nothing on who operates or owns the Fayda system.
No register keyed on the ID number is stated.

facts.fact: The Director of the National ID Program said on 9 December 2025 that each digital ID issued under the Fayda program is verifiable and legally recognised, with INSA now issuing certificates to secure it.
